research_question: At a fixed real interaction budget, does front-loading and then removing crafting practice improve original Crafter performance versus both natural-only training and the same amount of practice spread across training?

selection_evidence.interpretation: Opportunity coverage is incomplete while most opportunity-bearing episodes succeed; prioritize practice exposure, not loss weighting. Does not establish causation.

methods.fading_mix: Assisted blocks at even indices below60; all blocks60..119 natural

block_boundary: All groups reset at each2500 actual actions. Mark truncation as is_last=True, is_terminal=False; natural deaths remain terminal. Reset observations counted separately and not charged as physical actions. Policy carry resets. Disclose training horizon intervention shared by all groups.
assisted_reset: One practice scenario only: original generated map with one adjacent table and inventory wood=1. No granted tool, achievement, reward, stone, or invulnerability. Replace only chosen adjacent tile; remove its occupant if any and record. Returned image re-rendered after modification. Recipe, action space, rewards unchanged.
information: Actor/world model/critic receive original image and public signals only. Scenario, inventory metadata and eligibility are audit logs only.
training: Fresh unified JAX0.4.38 runtime, size12m, original Dreamer hyperparameters and train_ratio512; no development checkpoint initialization.

evaluation.policy: Sampled eval with config seed4003 and n_actions reset to episode*10001

comparison: fading versus natural measures practical adaptation; fading versus fixed_mix isolates temporal allocation with identical assisted action counts. Report each paired seed; no strong statistical claim.
resume_gate: 400-action uninterrupted-versus-two-restarts equality passed for288 arrays. Exact replay and runtime snapshots preserve continuation. WAL fsync before and after every physical action reports completed and ambiguous calls separately. Further5100-step curriculum boundary/resource preflight required.

scope: Only curriculum adaptation. No reward shaping, loss weighting, LLM, prioritized replay, or extra model.
